# dpkg

Description: Data frame, tibble, or tbl objects are converted to data
package objects using specific metadata labels (name, version, title,
homepage, description). A data package object (`dpkg`) can be written to
disk as a ‘parquet’ file or released to a ‘GitHub’ repository. Data
package objects can be read into R from online repositories and
downloaded files are cached locally across R sessions.

## Installation

Install the released version of dpkg from CRAN with:

``` r
install.packages("dpkg")
```

You can install the development version of dpkg from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("cole-brokamp/dpkg")
```

# Package index

## using a dpkg

- [`dpkg_meta()`](http://geomarker.io/codec/reference/dpkg_meta.md) :
  get the metadata associated with a data package
- [`read_dpkg_metadata()`](http://geomarker.io/codec/reference/read_dpkg.md)
  [`read_dpkg()`](http://geomarker.io/codec/reference/read_dpkg.md) :
  read (meta)data from dpkg on disk

## creating a dpkg

- [`as_dpkg()`](http://geomarker.io/codec/reference/as_dpkg.md) : Use a
  data.frame and metadata to create a data package
- [`write_dpkg()`](http://geomarker.io/codec/reference/write_dpkg.md) :
  write dpkg to disk
- [`dpkg_gh_release()`](http://geomarker.io/codec/reference/dpkg_gh_release.md)
  : Use a dpkg to create a github release
- [`use_dpkg_badge()`](http://geomarker.io/codec/reference/use_dpkg_badge.md)
  : Use a markdown badge for a dpkg's latest github release

## stow

- [`stow_gh_release()`](http://geomarker.io/codec/reference/stow.md)
  [`stow()`](http://geomarker.io/codec/reference/stow.md)
  [`stow_url()`](http://geomarker.io/codec/reference/stow.md) :

  download a github release asset to the `stow` R user directory

- [`stow_info()`](http://geomarker.io/codec/reference/stow_info.md)
  [`stow_path()`](http://geomarker.io/codec/reference/stow_info.md)
  [`stow_exists()`](http://geomarker.io/codec/reference/stow_info.md)
  [`stow_size()`](http://geomarker.io/codec/reference/stow_info.md)
  [`stow_remove()`](http://geomarker.io/codec/reference/stow_info.md) :
  get info about stowed files
